constraints.label: Org assignment has a subject
constraints.message: Org assignment writes must include employee and/or position

constraints.label: Org assignment has at most one manager
constraints.message: Org assignment writes must not include both reports_to_employee and reports_to_position

constraints.label: One active org assignment per employee or position
constraints.message: An employee or a position has at most one active org assignment on any date
constraints.notes: Mirrors org_assignment_import_reconciliation_policy subjects and effective fields; start_date and end_date are inclusive and an absent end_date is open.

field_metadata.notes: Unique employee reference. Often an internal HRIS number like EMP-001 or alphanumeric ID.
Employee's full display name, typically "First Last".
Confirmed alternate employee names used for deterministic import matching.
Current employment state: active, terminated, on leave, etc.
The employee's current job title, e.g. "Senior Software Engineer", "VP Sales".
Organizational department the employee belongs to: Engineering, Sales, Marketing, etc.
Office or work site. Often a city or office name like "SF HQ", "Remote - US", "New York"
Hire date or employment start date.
Last day of employment. Null if currently active.
Annual base salary. Currency amount, often with $ or /yr.
Annual target bonus amount or percentage of base.
Annual target commission amount. Typically for sales roles.
Employee's family/surname.
Employee's given/first name.
Corporate email address.
Job family grouping: Engineering, Design, Sales, Operations, etc.
Division or business unit within the organization. "EMEA", a product line, a geographical region.
Profit & loss line item classification.
Job level for compensation bands: L1, L2, IC3, M1, etc.
Unique position reference. Often a code like POS-001 or an alphanumeric ID.
Descriptive name for the budgeted position. "Senior Engineer", "Marketing Manager", etc.
Confirmed alternate position names used for deterministic import matching.
Open, Filled, Frozen, Eliminated, Hiring, etc.
Budgeted base salary for the position. Currency amount.
Budgeted target bonus amount.
Budgeted target commission amount.
Expected start date for the position.
Expected end date for the position.
Department the position is budgeted under.
Office, city or site for the position.
Business unit the position belongs to.
Job family grouping for the position.
Job or compensation level for the position.
Budgeted annual equity value.
Actual benefits cost for the position.
Actual employer tax cost.
P&L line item classification for this position's cost.
Employee occupying or participating in the assignment.
Position occupied or planned by the assignment.
Preferred manager target when a human manager is known.
Fallback manager target for empty-org planning.
